notes: Rig only draws joints the camera actually sees — no more head blob on your back or tangled lines. Face is one small head marker, hands are small clean dots and lines. Status lines tell the truth: Skeleton on only shows when the rig is really drawing, and hand signs name the camera that sees them. Hand signs really work from either camera, with a short grace so one dropped frame does not reset your hold. Hands are read on a bigger frame, so they are seen at arm's length.
